Pure two-party state, any finite dimensions: S(A)=S(B) (entropy_symm), equal moments and Schmidt rank, and reduced state pure iff product (pure_iff_product, via the Lagrange identity sum_minor_sq). Three parties: a pure pair leaves the third uncorrelated (monogamy_of_pure_pair); GHZ pair state is separable. Matrix facts; the self/other reading is interpretation

Minimal cuts of a weighted graph: complement symmetry (rt_compl), strong subadditivity (rt_submodular), monogamy of mutual information (rt_monogamy), so no graph has the 4-party GHZ entropy pattern (no_network_has_ghz_entropies); Schmidt rank at most D^|cut| under an assumed factorisation (schmidt_rank_le_cut). Graph facts only: min-cut = entropy for HaPPY is cited, not proved

Causal-set side: on a Fisher frame Beauvoir.Barbarian is exactly 'no common future' (barbarian_iff_beyond), which is inherited upward in any partial order (beyond_mono); in N x N spacelike points meet, so the light-cone lattice is not a Fisher frame (lightcone_not_frame).
